title: rk generated-artifact manifest (v1)
description: `.rk/generated.json` — the declared manifest src/gates/freshness.ts (Gate 7, IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md M2.6, docs/gate-contracts.md's Gate 7 section) reads: one entry per generated artifact a repo has adopted the freshness mechanism for. Untrusted, hand-editable JSON, same edge-trust posture as .rk/config.json — a malformed manifest is never a crash and never a silent no-op; the gate reports one ERROR per malformation. Optional file: its total absence is a legitimate, presence-conditional green state (the mechanism simply has not been adopted), never a finding.

schema_version.description: A version bump accompanies any incompatible shape change (CLAUDE.md rule 10), with a fixture.

entries.description: One row per adopted generated artifact. Order is not significant; the gate reports findings in array order.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the generated artifact, e.g. "argument/INDEX.md".

generator.description: Generator id this rk binary must recognize to regenerate `path`. Known ids: "linker-index" (argument/INDEX.md's render) and "linker-dag" (argument/DAG.md's render), both pure entries of src/gates/freshness.ts's GENERATORS map; "cards-v1" (rk-nsex — refs/cards/<source-id>/L1-<n>.md, rendered from the extraction record and its review record by src/render/cards.ts, written by `rk render cards`), also pure but ONE generator over many artifacts, so it is passed the declared path and may report that it cannot produce bytes for it; and "render-site-v1" (M2.4 `rk render`'s HTML output), which is EDGE-SUPPLIED — the gate never regenerates it itself and diffs bytes prepared by src/cli/check.ts. An id this binary recognizes as none of these is a BLOCKING ERROR, not the 'not adopted' state this field's description claimed before the M2 boundary review (blocker #3a): a typo'd id is indistinguishable from a forward-declaration of a not-yet-landed generator, so both must fail rather than green-light an unchecked artifact. See docs/gate-contracts.md's Gate 7 section.
